tokens.name: ui-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground (`.ui` paints it). Light is white; dark is near-black.

tokens.name: ui-surface
tokens.usage: Default component surface: appbar, panel, card foot; inputs and notices sit on it.

tokens.name: ui-surface-raised
tokens.usage: A surface lifted above `ui-surface`: buttons, cards, kbd, the pressed segment, the toggle knob, textarea.

tokens.name: ui-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: card foot, quiet buttons, segmented track, inline `.code`, kbd, meter track.

tokens.name: ui-border
tokens.usage: Hairlines and default control borders; the `.hr` rule. Measured 1.26:1 on white and 1.31:1 on dark `ui-bg`: a hairline, under the 3:1 a meaning-bearing border needs; kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: ui-border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that must hold their own: buttons, outline buttons, pills, kbd, hovered rows and hoverable cards, the toggle track. 1.58:1 on white; under 3:1, kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: ui-fg
tokens.usage: Body ink and headings on every surface: 17.4:1 on white, 16.2:1 on dark `ui-bg`.

tokens.name: ui-fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary ink (`.muted`, `.lead`, meta). 5.7:1 on white, 5.1:1 on `ui-sunken`; 6.6:1 on dark `ui-bg`, 5.9:1 on dark `ui-surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ui-fg-faint
tokens.usage: Decoration only (`.faint`, `.eyebrow`, timestamps), never the only carrier of meaning. 3.2:1 on white, 3.5:1 on dark `ui-bg`: under AA for small text in both themes, by design; a tinted row promotes it to `ui-fg-muted`.

tokens.name: ui-fg-inverse
tokens.usage: Ink on a `ui-fg` fill. Declared in both themes; no ui.css component reads it yet.

tokens.name: ui-accent
tokens.usage: The one voice per theme: sage `#476349` in light, brass `#cfa14d` in dark. Primary button fill, links, focus outline, toggle on, meter fill. As text: 6.7:1 on white (light), 8.4:1 on `ui-bg` (dark).

tokens.name: ui-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of an accent fill or link; in dark also the ink for soft-tinted pills (10.3:1 on `ui-bg`).

tokens.name: ui-accent-active
tokens.usage: Pressed accent fill.

tokens.name: ui-accent-fg
tokens.usage: Ink on an accent fill: white on sage (6.7:1), near-black on brass (8.0:1).

tokens.name: ui-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Accent tint: `.pill-accent`, `.is-current` row, `::selection`.

tokens.name: ui-accent-soft-fg
tokens.usage: Accent ink on `ui-accent-soft` (sage 5.7:1 on its own tint).

tokens.name: ui-accent-ring
tokens.usage: Translucent accent for link underlines and focus halos; not a text colour.

tokens.name: ui-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive and failed: `.btn-danger`, the `[aria-invalid]` ring, danger pills, notices, dots. 6.5:1 on white, 6.4:1 on dark `ui-bg`.

tokens.name: ui-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Danger tint behind danger ink.

tokens.name: ui-info
tokens.usage: Informational and replay states: `.btn-outline-info`, info pills, notices, dots. 6.5:1 on white, 8.0:1 on dark `ui-bg`.

tokens.name: ui-info-soft
tokens.usage: Info tint behind info ink.

tokens.name: ui-ok
tokens.usage: Healthy and connected. In light it is the sage accent itself; in dark the sage lifted to `#8fae94`, luminance-matched to brass.

tokens.name: ui-ok-soft
tokens.usage: Ok tint behind ok ink.

tokens.name: ui-warn
tokens.usage: Orange warn for fills, borders, dots and meter fills. Light `#c86a17` is 3.8:1 on white: sound for marks, under AA for small text; use `ui-warn-ink` for words.

tokens.name: ui-warn-ink
tokens.usage: Every light-mode warn TEXT colour: 5.9:1 on white, 5.3:1 on `ui-warn-soft`. Dark aliases back to `ui-warn` (8.1:1 on `ui-bg`).

tokens.name: ui-warn-soft
tokens.usage: Warn tint behind warn ink.
